word-store-1b.label: Fashion and style · запись 1.3
word-store-1b.text:
1. He/she knows what’s in fashion or out of fashion.
2. He/she likes to be the centre of attention.
3. He/she goes for a casual look.
4. He/she comes across as kind and friendly.
5. He/she cares a lot about his/her appearance.
6. He/she feels comfortable in his/her own skin.
7. He/she likes to go with the flow.
8. He/she is trendy.
word-store-1b.textLabel: Фразы из Word Store 1B для сверки
word-store-1b.source: Focus 3 Second Edition · SB стр. 5, упр. 7 · Word Store стр. 3, 1B

word-store-1c.label: Personality · запись 1.4
word-store-1c.text:
carefree — happy and without worries
down-to-earth — sensible and practical
rebellious — difficult or disobedient
shallow — not interested in serious things
easy-going — not easily upset or annoyed
vain — too proud of the way you look
word-store-1c.textLabel: Слова и определения из Word Store 1C
word-store-1c.source: Focus 3 Second Edition · SB стр. 5, упр. 9 · Word Store стр. 3, 1C
